spans.s:
(औ) r. 2d cl. (अत्ति)
To eat. The root is imperfect; घस being substituted for it in several inflections; as जघास, &c. Implying injury, it is not conjugated in the middle voice, although the action be reciprocal: as व्यत्यदन्ति they bite, or devour each other.
With an indicatory इ, अदि
(अन्दति)
To bind.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Awkward, unskilful.
E.
अ neg. दक्ष clever.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Not clever, unskilful.
2 Not comprehending the fee given to the Brahmans, a sacrifice, &c.
E.
अ neg. दक्षिण clever, or दक्षिणा a fee.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
Unscorched, not burnt.
E.
अ neg. दग्ध burnt.

mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डा-ण्डं)
Unpunished.
n. (-ण्डं)
Impunity.
E.
अ neg. दण्ड punishment.

mfn. (-ण्ड्यः-ण्ड्या-ण्ड्यं)
Unpunishable, unworthy of or exempt from punishment.
E.
अ neg. दण्ड्य to be punished.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Unpunishable, unfit to be punished, exempt from punishment.
E.
अ neg. दण्डनीय to be punished.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Not given.
f. (-त्ता)
An unmarried girl.
E.
अ not, दत्त given.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Taken, received.
E.
आङ् before दा, क्त aff.

Food.
2

Eating.
E.
अद to eat, and ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Not giving, withholding.
E.
अ neg. दान gift.

n. (-नं)
1 Taking, receipt, acceptance.
2 A horse's trappings.
3 A symptom.
f. (-नी)
A plant: see हस्तिघोषा.
E.
आङ् reversing the sense, and दा to give, ल्युट् affix, fem. ङीप्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be eaten, what may be eaten.
E.
अद to eat, अनीयर aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Toothless. So अदन्तक (-कः-का-कं)
E.
अ neg. दन्त a tooth.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Untamed, unsubdued, undaunted.
E.
अ neg. दान्त daunted.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
Uncontroulable, untameable.
E.
अ neg. दम्य to be tamed.

mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्रा-भ्रं)
Much, many.
E.
अ neg. दभ्र little, few.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Unfeeling, unmerciful, destitute of pity.
E.
अ neg. दया clemency.

ind.
Having taken.
E.
आङ् before दा to give, ल्यप् aff.

n. (-न)
Disappearance, not being visible or present.
E.
अ neg. दर्शन sight.

n. (-नं)
1 Showing, making apparent or seen.
2 A mirror.
E.
आङ् before दृश to see, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-लः)
A plant, (Eugenia acutangula.) See हिज्जल.
f. (-ला)
Socotrine aloe, (Aloes perfoliata.) See घृतकुमारी.
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Leafless.
E.
अ neg. and दल a leaf.

mfn. (असौ असौ अदः)
1

This.
2
That.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Incombustible; so अदाहनीय.
E.
अ neg. दाहनीय or दहनीय to be burnt.

m. (-ता)
A niggard, a miser.
E.
अ neg. दातृ who gives.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Unclaimed, as inheritance, lapsed.
2 Not relating to inheritance.
E.
अ neg. दाय heritage, ठक aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
Inconsumable by fire, incombustible.
E.
अ neg. दाह्य to be burnt.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Taking, accepting.
E.
आङ् before दा to give, affix शानच्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Having, possessing.
E.
आङ् before धा to have, शानच् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Respect, reverence.
2 Commencement, beginning.
E.
आङ्, दृ to have, अप् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Venerable, respectable.
2 To be attended to.
E.
आङ् before दृ to have, आनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be respected or regarded.
E.
आङ् ट्ट and तव्य aff.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
Venerable, respectable.
E.
आङ् before दृ to have, यत् aff.

m. (-र्शः)
1 A mirror.
2 A commentary.
3 The original manuscript from which a copy is taken.
E.
आङ्, दृशि to see, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shewn, made apparent.
E.
आङ् before दृश to see, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Who goes away after taking any thing.
E.
आदाय, चर to go, ट aff.
